solution:
\(\int \left( \sin x + \dfrac{1}{x} + \dfrac{1}{\sqrt[3]{x}} \right) dx\)
\(= \int \sin x\, dx + \int \dfrac{1}{x}\, dx + \int \dfrac{1}{\sqrt[3]{x}}\, dx\)
\(= \int \sin x\, dx + \int \dfrac{1}{x}\, dx + \int x^{-\frac{1}{3}}\, dx\)
\(= -\cos x + \log x + \dfrac{x^{-\frac{1}{3}+1}}{-\frac{1}{3}+1} + c\)
\(= -\cos x + \log x + \dfrac{x^{\frac{2}{3}}}{\frac{2}{3}} + c\)

\(\int (\tan x + \cot x)^2\, dx\)
\(= \int (\tan^2 x + 2 \tan x \cdot \cot x + \cot^2 x)\, dx\)
\(= \int (\tan^2 x + 2 + \cot^2 x)\, dx\)
\(= \int (\sec^2 x - 1 + 2 + \csc^2 x - 1)\, dx\)
\(= \int (\sec^2 x + \csc^2 x)\, dx\)
\(= \int \sec^2 x\, dx + \int \csc^2 x\, dx\)
\(= \tan x + (-\cot x) + c\)
\(= \tan x - \cot x + c\)

\(\int \dfrac{\sqrt{x} + 1}{x + \sqrt{x}}\, dx\)
\(= \int \dfrac{\sqrt{x} + 1}{\sqrt{x}\,(\sqrt{x} + 1)}\, dx\)
\(= \int \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{x}}\, dx\)
\(= 2 \cdot \int \dfrac{1}{2\sqrt{x}}\, dx\)
\(= 2\sqrt{x} + c\)

\(\int \dfrac{e^{4 \log x} - e^{5 \log x}}{x^5}\, dx\)
\(= \int \dfrac{e^{\log x^4} - e^{\log x^5}}{x^5}\, dx\), \(\quad \because a^{\log_a f(x)} = f(x)\)
\(= \int \left( \dfrac{x^4 - x^5}{x^5} \right) dx\)
\(= \int \left( \dfrac{1}{x} - 1 \right) dx\)
\(= \log(x) - x + c\)

Using \(\dfrac{N}{D} = Q + \dfrac{R}{D}\), divide \((2x+3)\) by \((5x-1)\): quotient \(= \dfrac{2}{5}\), remainder \(= 3 + \dfrac{2}{5} = \dfrac{17}{5}\).
\(\therefore 2x + 3 = \dfrac{2}{5}(5x - 1) + 3 + \dfrac{2}{5}\)
\(I = \int \left[ \dfrac{2}{5} + \dfrac{\frac{17}{5}}{5x - 1} \right] dx\)
\(= \dfrac{2}{5}x + \dfrac{17}{5} \log(5x - 1) \cdot \dfrac{1}{5} + c\)
\(= \dfrac{2}{5}x + \dfrac{17}{25} \log(5x - 1) + c\)

\(\int \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{3x + 1} - \sqrt{3x - 5}}\, dx\)
\(= \int \left( \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{3x + 1} - \sqrt{3x - 5}} \right) \cdot \left( \dfrac{\sqrt{3x + 1} + \sqrt{3x - 5}}{\sqrt{3x + 1} + \sqrt{3x - 5}} \right) dx\)
\(= \int \dfrac{\sqrt{3x + 1} + \sqrt{3x - 5}}{3x + 1 - 3x + 5}\, dx\)
\(= \int \dfrac{\sqrt{3x + 1} + \sqrt{3x - 5}}{6}\, dx\)
\(= \dfrac{1}{6} \cdot \int \left( (3x + 1)^{\frac{1}{2}} + (3x - 5)^{\frac{1}{2}} \right) dx\)
\(= \dfrac{1}{6} \cdot \left\{ \int (3x + 1)^{\frac{1}{2}}\, dx + \int (3x - 5)^{\frac{1}{2}}\, dx \right\}\)
\(= \dfrac{1}{6} \cdot \left\{ \dfrac{(3x + 1)^{\frac{1}{2} + 1}}{\left( \frac{1}{2} + 1 \right) \cdot 3} + \dfrac{(3x - 5)^{\frac{1}{2} + 1}}{\left( \frac{1}{2} + 1 \right) \cdot 3} \right\} + c\)
\(= \dfrac{1}{18} \cdot \left\{ \dfrac{2}{3}(3x + 1)^{\frac{3}{2}} + \dfrac{2}{3}(3x - 5)^{\frac{3}{2}} \right\} + c\)
\(= \dfrac{1}{27} \cdot \left\{ (3x + 1)^{\frac{3}{2}} + (3x - 5)^{\frac{3}{2}} \right\} + c\)

Express \((2x - 7)\) in terms of \((3x - 2)\):
\(2x - 7 = \dfrac{2}{3}(3x - 2) + \dfrac{4}{3} - 7 = \dfrac{2}{3}(3x - 2) - \dfrac{17}{3}\)
\(I = \int \left[ \dfrac{\frac{2}{3}(3x - 2) - \frac{17}{3}}{\sqrt{3x - 2}} \right] dx\)
\(= \int \left[ \dfrac{\frac{2}{3}(3x - 2)}{\sqrt{3x - 2}} - \dfrac{\frac{17}{3}}{\sqrt{3x - 2}} \right] dx\)
\(= \dfrac{2}{3} \int \sqrt{3x - 2}\, dx - \dfrac{17}{3} \int \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{3x - 2}}\, dx\)
\(= \dfrac{2}{3} \int (3x - 2)^{\frac{1}{2}}\, dx - \dfrac{17}{3} \int \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{3x - 2}}\, dx\)
\(= \dfrac{2}{3} \cdot \dfrac{(3x - 2)^{\frac{3}{2}}}{\frac{3}{2}} \cdot \dfrac{1}{3} - \dfrac{17}{3} \cdot 2 \cdot (\sqrt{3x - 2}) \cdot \dfrac{1}{3} + c\)
\(= \dfrac{4}{27} \cdot (3x - 2)^{\frac{3}{2}} - \dfrac{34}{9} \cdot (3x - 2)^{\frac{1}{2}} + c\)

\(I = \int \dfrac{x^3 - 1 + 1}{x - 1}\, dx\)
\(= \int \left( \dfrac{x^3 - 1}{x - 1} + \dfrac{1}{x - 1} \right) dx\)
\(= \int \left( \dfrac{(x - 1)(x^2 + x + 1)}{(x - 1)} + \dfrac{1}{x - 1} \right) dx\)
\(= \int \left( x^2 + x + 1 + \dfrac{1}{x - 1} \right) dx\)
\(= \dfrac{x^3}{3} + \dfrac{x^2}{2} + x + \log(x - 1) + c\)

\(I = \int \left( \dfrac{3^x}{5^x} - \dfrac{4^x}{5^x} \right) dx\)
\(= \int \left[ \left( \dfrac{3}{5} \right)^x - \left( \dfrac{4}{5} \right)^x \right] dx\)
\(= \dfrac{\left( \frac{3}{5} \right)^x}{\log \frac{3}{5}} - \dfrac{\left( \frac{4}{5} \right)^x}{\log \frac{4}{5}} + c\)

\(\cos 3A = 4 \cos^3 A - 3 \cos A\)
\(I = \int \dfrac{1}{4}(\cos 3x + 3 \cos x)\, dx\)
\(= \dfrac{1}{4} \left( \sin 3x \cdot \dfrac{1}{3} + 3 \cdot \sin x \right) + c\)
\(= \dfrac{1}{12} \sin 3x + \dfrac{3}{4} \sin x + c\)

\(I = \int \sqrt{\cos^2 \dfrac{3x}{2} + \sin^2 \dfrac{3x}{2} + 2 \sin \dfrac{3x}{2} \cdot \cos \dfrac{3x}{2}}\, dx\)
\(= \int \sqrt{\left( \cos \dfrac{3x}{2} + \sin \dfrac{3x}{2} \right)^2}\, dx\)
\(= \int \left( \cos \dfrac{3x}{2} + \sin \dfrac{3x}{2} \right) dx\)
\(= \sin \dfrac{3x}{2} \cdot \dfrac{1}{\frac{3}{2}} - \cos \dfrac{3x}{2} \cdot \dfrac{1}{\frac{3}{2}} + c\)
\(= \dfrac{2}{3} \left( \sin \dfrac{3x}{2} - \cos \dfrac{3x}{2} \right) + c\)

\(I = \int (\sin^2 x)^2\, dx\)
\(= \int \left( \dfrac{1}{2}(1 - \cos 2x) \right)^2 dx\)
\(= \dfrac{1}{4} \cdot \int (1 - 2 \cos 2x + \cos^2 2x)\, dx\)
\(= \dfrac{1}{4} \cdot \int \left[ 1 - 2 \cos 2x + \dfrac{1}{2}(1 + \cos 4x) \right] dx\)
\(= \dfrac{1}{4} \cdot \int \left( 1 - 2 \cos 2x + \dfrac{1}{2} + \dfrac{1}{2} \cos 4x \right) dx\)
\(= \dfrac{1}{4} \cdot \int \left( \dfrac{3}{2} - 2 \cos 2x + \dfrac{1}{2} \cos 4x \right) dx\)
\(= \dfrac{1}{4} \cdot \left[ \dfrac{3}{2}x - 2 \sin 2x \cdot \dfrac{1}{2} + \dfrac{1}{2} \sin 4x \cdot \dfrac{1}{4} \right] + c\)
\(= \dfrac{1}{4} \cdot \left[ \dfrac{3}{2}x - \sin 2x + \dfrac{1}{8} \sin 4x \right] + c\)

We know that \(2 \sin A \cdot \cos B = \sin(A + B) + \sin(A - B)\)
\(I = \dfrac{1}{2} \int 2 \sin 5x \cdot \cos 7x\, dx\)
\(= \dfrac{1}{2} \int [\sin(5x + 7x) + \sin(5x - 7x)]\, dx\)
\(= \dfrac{1}{2} \int [\sin(12x) + \sin(-2x)]\, dx\)
\(= \dfrac{1}{2} \int (\sin 12x - \sin 2x)\, dx\)
\(= \dfrac{1}{2} \cdot \left[ -\cos 12x \cdot \dfrac{1}{12} + \cos 2x \cdot \dfrac{1}{2} \right] + c\)
\(I = -\dfrac{1}{24} \cos 12x + \dfrac{1}{4} \cos 2x + c\)

stem: Evaluate: \(\int \dfrac{\sin^3 x - \cos^3 x}{\sin^2 x \cdot \cos^2 x}\, dx\)
solution:
\(I = \int \left( \dfrac{\sin^3 x}{\sin^2 x \cdot \cos^2 x} - \dfrac{\cos^3 x}{\sin^2 x \cdot \cos^2 x} \right) dx\)
\(= \int \left( \dfrac{\sin x}{\cos^2 x} - \dfrac{\cos x}{\sin^2 x} \right) dx\)
\(= \int \left( \dfrac{1}{\cos x} \cdot \dfrac{\sin x}{\cos x} - \dfrac{1}{\sin x} \cdot \dfrac{\cos x}{\sin x} \right) dx\)
\(= \int (\sec x \cdot \tan x - \csc x \cdot \cot x)\, dx\)
\(= \sec x - (-\csc x) + c\)
\(I = \sec x + \csc x + c\)

\(I = \int \left( \dfrac{1}{1 - \sin x} \right) \left( \dfrac{1 + \sin x}{1 + \sin x} \right) dx\)
\(= \int \dfrac{1 + \sin x}{1 - \sin^2 x}\, dx\)
\(= \int \dfrac{1 + \sin x}{\cos^2 x}\, dx\)
\(= \int \left( \dfrac{1}{\cos^2 x} + \dfrac{\sin x}{\cos^2 x} \right) dx\)
\(= \int (\sec^2 x + \sec x \cdot \tan x)\, dx\)
\(= \tan x + \sec x + c\)

\(I = \int \left( \dfrac{\cos x}{1 - \cos x} \right) \left( \dfrac{1 + \cos x}{1 + \cos x} \right) dx\)
\(= \int \dfrac{\cos x\,(1 + \cos x)}{1 - \cos^2 x}\, dx\)
\(= \int \left( \dfrac{\cos x + \cos^2 x}{\sin^2 x} \right) dx\)
\(= \int \left( \dfrac{\cos x}{\sin^2 x} + \dfrac{\cos^2 x}{\sin^2 x} \right) dx\)
\(= \int (\csc x \cdot \cot x + \cot^2 x)\, dx\)
\(= \int (\csc x \cdot \cot x + \csc^2 x - 1)\, dx\)
\(= (-\csc x) + (-\cot x) - x + c\)
\(= -\csc x - \cot x - x + c\)

\(\int \dfrac{\cos x - \cos 2x}{1 - \cos x}\, dx\)
\(= \int \dfrac{\cos x - (2 \cos^2 x - 1)}{1 - \cos x}\, dx\)
\(= \int \dfrac{\cos x - 2 \cos^2 x + 1}{1 - \cos x}\, dx\)
\(= \int \dfrac{\cos x\,(1 - \cos x) + (1 - \cos^2 x)}{1 - \cos x}\, dx\)
\(= \int \left[ \cos x + \dfrac{1 - \cos^2 x}{1 - \cos x} \right] dx\)
\(= \int [\cos x + (1 + \cos x)]\, dx\)
\(= \int (1 + 2 \cos x)\, dx\)
\(= x + 2 \sin x + c\)

\(I = \int \sin^{-1}\left( \sin \left( \dfrac{\pi}{2} - 3x \right) \right) dx\)
\(= \int \left( \dfrac{\pi}{2} - 3x \right) dx\)
\(= \dfrac{\pi}{2}x - 3 \cdot \dfrac{x^2}{2} + c\)

\(I = \int \cot^{-1}\left( \dfrac{1 + \cos 2x}{\sin 2x} \right) dx\)
\(= \int \cot^{-1}\left( \dfrac{2 \cos^2 x}{2 \sin x \cdot \cos x} \right) dx\)
\(= \int \cot^{-1}(\cot x)\, dx\)
\(= \int x\, dx = \dfrac{x^2}{2} + c\)

\(I = \int \tan^{-1} \sqrt{\dfrac{1 - \cos \left( \frac{\pi}{2} - x \right)}{1 + \cos \left( \frac{\pi}{2} - x \right)}}\, dx\)
\(= \int \tan^{-1} \sqrt{\dfrac{2 \sin^2 \left( \frac{\pi}{4} - \frac{x}{2} \right)}{2 \cos^2 \left( \frac{\pi}{4} - \frac{x}{2} \right)}}\, dx\)
\(= \int \tan^{-1} \sqrt{\tan^2 \left( \dfrac{\pi}{4} - \dfrac{x}{2} \right)}\, dx\)
\(= \int \tan^{-1}\left[ \tan \left( \dfrac{\pi}{4} - \dfrac{x}{2} \right) \right] dx\)
\(= \int \left( \dfrac{\pi}{4} - \dfrac{x}{2} \right) dx\)
\(= \dfrac{\pi}{4}x - \dfrac{1}{2} \cdot \dfrac{x^2}{2} + c\)
\(= \dfrac{\pi}{4}x - \dfrac{x^2}{4} + c\)
